sloka: नीलेन सह संयुक्तं रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम् ।अन्येन युद्ध्यमानस्य न युक्तमभिधावनम् ।। ६.५९.७४ ।।।।
transliteration: nīlena saha saṁyuktaṁ rāvaṇaṁ rākṣaseśvaram ।anyena yuddhyamānasya na yuktamabhidhāvanam ।। 6.59.74 ।।।।

translations.english: Endowed with a great mind and energetic Hanuman became alert and seeking to fight with Ravana, feeling fresh, enraged, looking at Nila said "It is not correct to attack one who is fighting with another."
